1. Power System Studies (PSS) · Load Flow, Short Circuit, Arc Flash NFPA 70E + IEEE 1584, Protection Coordination, Transient Stability, Harmonics, Motor Starting, Insulation Coordination, Reliability, DC Arc Flash · sign-off platforms: ETAP, DigSILENT, PSCAD
2. 3D LiDAR Scanning · Leica RTC360 + Faro Focus + ZEB Horizon · 50,000+ scans delivered
3. As-Built Engineering · P&ID, isometric, GA, process drawings · LiDAR-powered · 3,000+ km P&ID
4. FlexSim Discrete Event Simulation · manufacturing flow, ports, mining, healthcare, airports
5. Risk Assessments · HAZOP, QRA, LOPA, SIL
6. Safety Audits + Arc Flash AMC · 5-year NFPA 70E recertification retainer (VB Arc360)
7. Simulation Software Services · 9 approved platforms only (ETAP, DigSILENT, PSCAD, FlexSim, AnyLogic, Simio, AspenPlus, HYSYS, gPROMS)
